mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_profile (platform, bot_id, group_id, active_hours, vibe_baseline, topic_dist, active_members) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{activeHours}, #{vibeBaseline}, #{topicDist}, #{activeMembers}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active_hours = COALESCE (VALUES (active_hours), active_hours), vibe_baseline = COALESCE (VALUES (vibe_baseline), vibe_baseline), topic_dist = COALESCE (VALUES (topic_dist), topic_dist), active_members = COALESCE (VALUES (active_members), active_members)
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, active_hours AS activeHours, vibe_baseline AS vibeBaseline, topic_dist AS topicDist, active_members AS activeMembers, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM group_profile WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
